description:
Memory Games: Brain Training are logic games to train your memory and attention. While playing our brain games, you not only have a lot of fun, but also gradually improve your memory, attention and concentration. We offer 21 logic games to train your memory.

Over 1 000 000 users have chosen to train their IQ and memory with our app. Join the ever expanding brain training programs (brain games) and give your cognitive skills a boost. Try it now!

Memory Games features:
- simple and useful logic games
- easy memory training
- play without internet connection on the way to work or home
- train for 2-5 minutes to see improvements

Games For Training Your Memory

Useful, easy and fun ways to train your visual memory. Games ranging from easy to difficult. Watch and be amazed with your progress!

Memory Grid
 The most straightforward and beginner-friendly game for training memory. All you need is to memorize the positions of green cells. What can be simpler, right? The game board will contain green cells. You need to memorize their positions. After cells get hidden you’ll need to click on the green cells positions to uncover them. If you make a mistake - use replay or hint to complete the level. Number of green cells and game board size gets increased with each level which makes later levels of the game challenging even for experienced players.

As soon as you feel comfortable with simpler games and want more challenges move on to more challenging levels for training your memory: Logic games, Rotating Grid, Memory Hex, Who’s new? Count ’em all, Follow the Path, Image Vortex, Catch them and many others.

Our games allow you to train your visual memory as well as track your progress.

Games For Training Your Mind 

Our games are designed to increase your brain performance. Our brain can not be stretched or built like muscles as you walk. The more you exercise your brain the more neural connections created in your brain. The more your brain activity - the more oxygen rich blood gets there.

How to improve your logic? It's very simple, install our application and train your memory every day while playing.
